previous_statement: The two maps T:U→V and S:V→U in node 1.1 are injective: the first comparison estimate, including its X=0 case, forces TX=0 only when X=0, and the second forces SY=0 only when Y=0.
new_statement: The comparison maps in node 1.1 are injective. Indeed, if TX=0 then ||X||=||TX-X||≤(1/2)||X||, so X=0; and if SY=0 then ||Y||=||SY-Y||≤(1/2)||Y||, so Y=0.
